requirement.description: The hashlib module doesn't have keccak_256 attribute, causing AttributeError in EIP712 tests. The code is trying to use hashlib.keccak_256 but this method doesn't exist in the standard hashlib module.
requirement.contract: The hashes.py module should properly implement keccak hashing using either pysha3 or pycryptodome libraries as fallbacks, not relying on hashlib.keccak_256.

requirement.description: The sign_transaction function is missing required chain_id parameter in the function signature, causing TypeError when called from tests.
requirement.contract: The sign_transaction function must accept chain_id as a keyword-only argument and properly handle it during transaction signing.

requirement.description: The binary module is missing the verify_signature function that is referenced in test_recover_address.
requirement.contract: Add the verify_signature function to the binary module's exports and implementation.

requirement.description: Command specifications are missing required keys (args, examples, help, name) which causes assertion failures in CLI subcommand tests.
requirement.contract: Ensure all CLI command specs have the required keys: args, examples, help, name, and that they conform to toolcli.CommandSpec interface.

requirement.description: Missing import for verify_signature function in the signatures module's __init__.py
requirement.contract: Add verify_signature to the exports in the signatures module's __init__.py
